newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel, Palestinians clash near Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Israel, Palestinians clash near Hebron.

text.p: Israeli soldiers fired tear gas and rubber bullets at stone-throwing Palestinian demonstrators in two villages near Hebron in the West Bank on Saturday, witnesses said.
In Halhoul, witnesses said Palestinian youths blocked roads with burning tyres and boulders to keep Israeli military vehicles from entering the village.
Israeli troops fired tear gas and rubber bullets at demonstrators in Beit Umar. No injuries were reported.
The sporadic clashes came after three days of fierce fighting between Israeli soldiers and Palestinians left 68 dead -- 54 Palestinians and 14 Israelis -- in the West Bank, Gaza and Jerusalem.
Witnesses said the atmosphere around Hebron, the last Palestinian city entirely under Israeli military control, was tense.
Israeli and PLO security forces have increased their presence at likely flashpoints in anticipation of possible flare-ups, but most of the West Bank and Gaza was quiet on Saturday morning.
